 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to design, develop and maintain scalable automated testing solutions for business-critical lending applications and services. This role is ideal for an experienced, hands-on QA engineer with strong expertise in API test automation, C# and .NET, backend testing and enterprise system integration, capable of ensuring the quality and reliability of complex loan origination and processing workflows.
 Main tech: #QAautomation #CSharp #NET #APITesting #RESTAPIs #NUnit #xUnit #Postman #RestAssured #Microservices #CICD #Jenkins #GitHubActions
 Key Responsibilities 
 Test Automation & Framework Development • Design, develop and maintain automated testing frameworks for API and backend services using C# and .NET
 • Build reliable automated tests covering functional, integration, regression and end-to-end scenarios
 • Develop reusable and maintainable test automation components aligned with engineering best practices
 • Review, optimize and enhance existing automation suites to improve test coverage, execution efficiency and reliability
 • Define and promote automation standards, coding guidelines and testing best practices
 API & Backend Testing • Design and execute comprehensive automated tests for REST APIs, microservices and enterprise integrations
 • Validate API functionality, request and response payloads, error handling, authentication and data consistency
 • Perform negative testing, contract testing and integration testing across interconnected systems
 • Test synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven integrations supporting loan processing workflows
 • Analyze API responses, application logs and system interactions to identify and troubleshoot defects
 Quality Engineering & Test Strategy • Define test strategies, automation approaches and coverage requirements for new features and system enhancements
 • Ensure adequate test coverage for critical loan origination and processing business flows
 • Participate in requirements analysis and solution design reviews to identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle
 • Support shift-left testing practices and continuous quality improvement
 • Collaborate with developers and business analysts to ensure business requirements are translated into effective test scenarios
 CI/CD Integration & Quality Assurance • Integrate automated testing suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalent tools
 • Monitor automated test execution, investigate failures and improve test stability and reliability
 • Support deployment validation, regression testing and production readiness activities
 • Provide test execution reports, automation coverage metrics and quality insights to project stakeholders
 • Collaborate closely with developers, solution architects, product owners and other engineering teams in an Agile environment
 What will drive your success? • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in QA Automation, preferably in enterprise environments
 • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with API test automation
 • Strong hands-on programming experience with C# and practical experience working with .NET / .NET Core
 • Experience designing, developing and maintaining automated testing frameworks using NUnit, xUnit or equivalent frameworks
 • Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS and API testing principles
 • Hands-on experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia, RestAssured or equivalent solutions
 • Good knowledge of API authentication and authorization mechanisms, including OAuth 2.0, JWT and Basic Authentication
 • Experience working with Swagger / OpenAPI specifications and validating API contracts
 • Strong experience testing backend services, microservices and applications with multiple system integrations
 • Ability to design and execute functional, integration, regression, negative and end-to-end automated tests
 • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalent tooling
 • Good working knowledge of Git and version control best practices
 • Experience using test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Xray or Zephyr
 • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques and quality engineering principles
 • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborating with cross-functional development teams
 • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate complex system interactions and identify root causes
 • High level of autonomy, ownership, attention to detail and commitment to software quality
 • Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders
 Nice to Have • Experience in banking, financial services or lending applications
 • Familiarity with loan origination, loan processing and financial transaction workflows
 • Experience testing event-driven architectures and message brokers such as Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ
 • Knowledge of performance testing, API security testing and non-functional testing practices
 • Familiarity with distributed systems, asynchronous processing and data consistency validation
 • Experience with containerized applications and cloud-native environments
 • Experience contributing to test automation architecture, framework standardization and continuous improvement initiatives
